-- Explicit bounded calendar; Oct 1 starts the next federal fiscal year.
with dates as (
 
 select dateadd(day, row_number() over(order by seq4()) - 1, date '2000-01-01')::date as calendar_date
 from table(generator(rowcount => 13149))
 
)
select cast(extract(year from calendar_date)*10000 + extract(month from calendar_date)*100 + extract(day from calendar_date) as integer) as date_key,
 calendar_date, cast(extract(year from calendar_date) as integer) as calendar_year,
 cast(extract(month from calendar_date) as integer) as calendar_month,
 cast(extract(day from calendar_date) as integer) as day_of_month,
 cast(extract(quarter from calendar_date) as integer) as calendar_quarter,
 cast(extract(year from calendar_date) + case when extract(month from calendar_date)>=10 then 1 else 0 end as integer) as fiscal_year,
 cast(case when extract(month from calendar_date)>=10 then 1
           when extract(month from calendar_date)>=7 then 4
           when extract(month from calendar_date)>=4 then 3 else 2 end as integer) as fiscal_quarter
from dates

-- Latest observed fiscal year first; richer LCA then source key break ties.
-- This is an observation selection policy, never a historical effective date.
with ranked as (
 select *, row_number() over (
   partition by employer_id
   order by is_source_active desc, source_fiscal_year desc,
     case when source_system = 'lca' then 0 else 1 end,
     source_system, source_employer_key
 ) as selection_rank,
 max(case when is_source_active then 1 else 0 end) over(partition by employer_id) as has_active_source
 from RAW.LCA.DIMENSIONS_INPUT_EMPLOYER_SOURCES
 where employer_id is not null
)
select employer_id, source_name as employer_name, state, country, city, postcode,
 source_system as attribute_source_system, source_employer_key as attribute_source_key,
 source_fiscal_year, source_observation_period, resolution_status, match_method,
 has_active_source = 1 as is_source_active,
 'UNVALIDATED_HUMAN_LABELS_REQUIRED' as identity_quality_status
from ranked where selection_rank = 1

with counties as (
 select county_fips, state_code, min(county_name) as county_name,
        geography_vintage as county_reference_vintage
 from ANALYTICS.STAGING.county_fips group by county_fips, state_code, geography_vintage
 union all
 select county_fips,state_code,county_name,county_reference_vintage
 from ANALYTICS.STAGING.ref_county_2023
)
select md5(c.county_reference_vintage||'|'||c.county_fips) as geography_key,
 c.county_fips, substr(c.county_fips,1,2) as state_fips, c.state_code,
 c.county_name, c.county_reference_vintage,
 case when c.state_code = 'CT' and c.county_reference_vintage = 'Census2020' then null else b.cbsa_code end as cbsa_code,
 case when c.state_code = 'CT' and c.county_reference_vintage = 'Census2020' then null else b.cbsa_title end as cbsa_title,
 case when c.state_code = 'CT' and c.county_reference_vintage = 'Census2020' then null else b.cbsa_type end as cbsa_type,
 case when g.county_fips is not null then 'CBSA2023-07' else null end as cbsa_vintage,
 case when c.state_code = 'CT' and c.county_reference_vintage = 'Census2020' then 'REQUIRES_CT_BRIDGE'
      when g.county_fips is null then 'OUTSIDE_2023_REFERENCE'
      when b.cbsa_code is null then 'NON_CBSA_2023'
      when c.county_reference_vintage = 'Census2020' then 'CODE_CONTINUITY_TO_2023'
      else 'MATCHED_2023' end as cbsa_status,
 g.county_internal_latitude, g.county_internal_longitude,
 case when g.county_fips is not null then 'Census2023' else null end as coordinate_reference_vintage,
 'COUNTY_INTERNAL_POINT_NOT_WORKSITE' as coordinate_semantics,
 'COUNTY' as geography_level,cast(null as varchar) as area_type,cast(null as varchar) as area_code,
 c.county_name as geography_title,c.county_reference_vintage as geography_vintage
from counties c
left join ANALYTICS.STAGING.ref_county_2023 g on c.county_fips = g.county_fips
left join ANALYTICS.STAGING.ref_county_cbsa_2023 b on c.county_fips = b.county_fips
union all
select md5(a.geography_vintage||'|'||a.area_type||'|'||a.area_code),
 cast(null as varchar),cast(null as varchar),a.state_raw,
 cast(null as varchar),cast(null as varchar),cast(null as varchar),cast(null as varchar),
 cast(null as varchar),cast(null as varchar),'BLS_AREA_NOT_COUNTY',
 cast(null as decimal(10,7)),cast(null as decimal(10,7)),cast(null as varchar),
 'NO_WORKSITE_COORDINATE',
 case a.area_type when '1' then 'NATIONAL' when '2' then 'STATE' when '3' then 'TERRITORY'
 when '4' then 'MSA' when '6' then 'BLS_NONMETROPOLITAN' end,
 a.area_type,a.area_code,a.area_title,a.geography_vintage
from ANALYTICS.STAGING.ref_bls_areas_2025 a

select md5(s.soc_vintage||'|'||s.soc_code) as occupation_key,
 s.soc_code, s.soc_title, s.soc_level, s.soc_vintage,
 s.major_code, major.soc_title as major_title,
 s.minor_code, minor.soc_title as minor_title,
 s.broad_code, broad.soc_title as broad_title, s.parent_code,
 'STANDARD_SOC' as classification_type
from ANALYTICS.STAGING.ref_soc_2018 s
left join ANALYTICS.STAGING.ref_soc_2018 major on s.major_code = major.soc_code
left join ANALYTICS.STAGING.ref_soc_2018 minor on s.minor_code = minor.soc_code
left join ANALYTICS.STAGING.ref_soc_2018 broad on s.broad_code = broad.soc_code
union all
select md5(s.soc_vintage||'|'||s.soc_code), s.soc_code,s.soc_title,s.soc_level,s.soc_vintage,
 s.major_code,major.soc_title,cast(null as varchar),cast(null as varchar),
 cast(null as varchar),cast(null as varchar),s.major_code,s.classification_type
from ANALYTICS.STAGING.ref_oews_2025 s
left join ANALYTICS.STAGING.ref_soc_2018 major on s.major_code=major.soc_code

select dbt_scd_id as employer_key, employer_id, employer_name,

select soc_code as problem from ANALYTICS.MARTS.dim_occupation s
where soc_vintage = 'SOC2018' and (major_title is null
 or (soc_level <> 'major' and (parent_code is null or minor_title is null))
 or (soc_level = 'detailed' and broad_title is null))
union all
select s.soc_code from ANALYTICS.MARTS.dim_occupation s
left join ANALYTICS.MARTS.dim_occupation p on s.parent_code = p.soc_code
where s.soc_vintage = 'SOC2018' and s.soc_level <> 'major' and (p.soc_code is null or p.major_code <> s.major_code)
union all
select county_fips from ANALYTICS.MARTS.dim_geography
where (cbsa_status = 'REQUIRES_CT_BRIDGE' and cbsa_code is not null)
 or (cbsa_code is not null and cbsa_vintage <> 'CBSA2023-07')
 or (cbsa_status = 'NON_CBSA_2023' and cbsa_code is not null)
union all
select cast(date_key as varchar) from ANALYTICS.MARTS.dim_date
where fiscal_year <> calendar_year + case when calendar_month >= 10 then 1 else 0 end
 or (calendar_month = 10 and fiscal_quarter <> 1)
union all
select 'SOC_REFERENCE_ROW_MISSING_OR_EXTRA' from (
 select coalesce(d.soc_code,r.soc_code) as soc_code
 from ANALYTICS.MARTS.dim_occupation d full join ANALYTICS.STAGING.ref_soc_2018 r
   on d.soc_code=r.soc_code and d.soc_vintage='SOC2018'
 where d.soc_code is null or (r.soc_code is null and d.soc_vintage='SOC2018')
) missing
union all
select 'INCORRECT_PARENT_LEVEL' from ANALYTICS.MARTS.dim_occupation s
join ANALYTICS.MARTS.dim_occupation p on s.parent_code=p.soc_code
where s.soc_vintage='SOC2018' and ((s.soc_level='detailed' and p.soc_level<>'broad')
 or (s.soc_level='broad' and p.soc_level<>'minor')
 or (s.soc_level='minor' and p.soc_level<>'major'))
union all
select soc_code from ANALYTICS.MARTS.dim_occupation
where soc_vintage='OEWS_May2025' and
 ((classification_type='OEWS_SPECIFIC' and (major_title is null or major_code is null))
 or (classification_type='AGGREGATE_TOTAL' and (major_code is not null or soc_code<>'00-0000')))

-- UTC capture-time intervals are half open. NULL exclusively denotes infinity.
with versions as (select * from ANALYTICS.MARTS.dim_employer),
invalid as (
 select employer_id from versions
 where valid_from is null or (valid_to is not null and valid_to <= valid_from)
    or is_current is null or is_current <> (valid_to is null)
 union all
 select employer_id from versions group by employer_id
 having sum(case when is_current then 1 else 0 end) <> 1
 union all
 select employer_id from versions group by employer_id, valid_from having count(*) > 1
 union all
 select a.employer_id from versions a join versions b
   on a.employer_id = b.employer_id and a.valid_from < b.valid_from
  and (a.valid_to is null or b.valid_from < a.valid_to)
  and (b.valid_to is null or a.valid_from < b.valid_to)
)
select * from invalid

-- One diagnostic for every input LCA occurrence. Bad source values remain visible.
select l.*,
 o.occupation_key, g.geography_key, x.employer_id,
 case when l.soc_code_raw is null or trim(l.soc_code_raw) = '' then 'SOURCE_SOC_MISSING'
      when l.soc_code is null then 'SOURCE_SOC_MALFORMED'
      when o.occupation_key is null then 'SOC_NOT_IN_2018_REFERENCE'
      else 'MATCHED' end as occupation_mapping_status,
 case when l.geography_status not in ('MATCHED','MATCHED_FROM_ZIP','MATCHED_FROM_CITY') then l.geography_status
      when g.geography_key is null then 'DIMENSION_COUNTY_MAPPING_FAILED'
      else 'MATCHED' end as county_mapping_status,
 g.cbsa_status,
 case when x.employer_id is null then 'UNRESOLVED_SOURCE_EMPLOYER'
      when first_snapshot.first_valid_from is null then 'DIMENSION_EMPLOYER_MAPPING_FAILED'
      when l.decision_date is null then 'SOURCE_FACT_DATE_MISSING'
      when l.decision_date < first_snapshot.first_valid_from then 'PRE_SNAPSHOT_HISTORY_UNKNOWN'
      else 'CAPTURE_TIME_LOOKUP_REQUIRED' end as employer_history_status
from RAW.LCA.DIMENSIONS_INPUT_LCA_ATTRIBUTES l
left join ANALYTICS.MARTS.dim_occupation o on l.soc_code = o.soc_code and o.soc_vintage = 'SOC2018'
left join ANALYTICS.MARTS.dim_geography g
 on l.county_fips = g.county_fips and l.geography_vintage = g.county_reference_vintage
left join RAW.LCA.DIMENSIONS_INPUT_EMPLOYER_SOURCES x
 on l.source_system = x.source_system and l.source_employer_key = x.source_employer_key
left join (select employer_id,min(valid_from) as first_valid_from from ANALYTICS.MARTS.dim_employer group by employer_id) first_snapshot
 on x.employer_id = first_snapshot.employer_id

-- These gates validate coverage and classification, not raw source quality.
select 'ROW_LOSS_OR_DUPLICATION' as problem
where (select count(*) from ANALYTICS.INTERMEDIATE.int_dimension_mapping)
   <> (select count(*) from RAW.LCA.DIMENSIONS_INPUT_LCA_ATTRIBUTES)
union all
select 'UNCLASSIFIED_MAPPING' from ANALYTICS.INTERMEDIATE.int_dimension_mapping
where occupation_mapping_status is null or county_mapping_status is null
 or county_mapping_status = 'DIMENSION_COUNTY_MAPPING_FAILED'
 or employer_history_status = 'DIMENSION_EMPLOYER_MAPPING_FAILED'
 or (occupation_mapping_status = 'MATCHED' and occupation_key is null)
 or (employer_id is not null and employer_history_status is null)
union all
select 'DUPLICATE_SOURCE_OCCURRENCE' from ANALYTICS.INTERMEDIATE.int_dimension_mapping
group by source_system,source_release,source_sha256,source_row_number having count(*)<>1
union all
select 'ROW_PROVENANCE_LOSS' from (
 select source_system,source_release,source_sha256,source_row_number
 from RAW.LCA.DIMENSIONS_INPUT_LCA_ATTRIBUTES
 except
 select source_system,source_release,source_sha256,source_row_number
 from ANALYTICS.INTERMEDIATE.int_dimension_mapping
) lost
union all
select 'UNKNOWN_DIAGNOSTIC_STATUS' from ANALYTICS.INTERMEDIATE.int_dimension_mapping
where occupation_mapping_status not in ('MATCHED','SOURCE_SOC_MISSING','SOURCE_SOC_MALFORMED','SOC_NOT_IN_2018_REFERENCE')
 or county_mapping_status not in ('MATCHED','SOURCE_COUNTY_MISSING','UNRESOLVED_COUNTY')
